name: LEN
description: LEN returns the number of characters in a text string.
tldr: LEN counts the number of characters in a text string.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text string whose length you want to find.

basicExample.explanation: Returns the number of characters in "Hello".

advancedExamples.title: Check password length
advancedExamples.description: Verify if a password meets minimum length requirements
advancedExamples.explanation: Checks if the password has at least 8 characters.

advancedExamples.title: Count characters excluding spaces
advancedExamples.description: Count characters in a string without spaces
advancedExamples.explanation: Removes all spaces before counting characters.

howItWorks: LEN counts every character in the text string, including spaces, punctuation, and special characters.

howToSteps.name: Select output cell
howToSteps.text: Choose where the result should appear.

howToSteps.name: Press Enter
howToSteps.text: The result shows the character count.

limitations: LEN counts each character as 1, including spaces and special characters.
For double-byte languages (like Chinese), use LENB instead.

commonErrors.fix: Ensure the argument is text or a cell reference.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: LEN works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: Does LEN count spaces?
faq.answer: Yes, LEN counts every character including spaces.

faq.question: What is the difference between LEN and LENB?
faq.answer: LEN counts characters, LENB counts bytes. For double-byte characters, LENB counts 2 bytes per character.
